description: This file contains a test class 'ModulesMetaCest' that includes automated tests for various metadata-related API endpoints related to modules in SuiteCRM, such as retrieving metadata, layout information, favorites, recently viewed records, filters, and menus. The tests involve sending HTTP requests, verifying responses, and creating sample data.

classes.name: ModulesMetaCest
classes.description: A test class for metadata endpoints of modules in SuiteCRM, covering module meta info, attributes, menu, layout, favorites, recently viewed, filters, and modules menus.

methods.description: Initializes fake data generator and seed before each test.
